ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; approximately 15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal regions versus 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the central and proximal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular jagged indentation/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe, located approximately midway between the median notch and the distal tip.
